INSERT INTO `like`
user_id, blog_id, comment_id, like_time,
#{userId}, #{blogId}, #{commentId}, #{likeTime},
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.cover, b.views, b.likes, b.dislikes, b.collections, b.publish_time, b.create_time, u.id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar, c.name AS category FROM `like` l JOIN blog b ON l.blog_id = b.id JOIN user u ON b.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.comment_id IS NULL ORDER BY l.like_time DESC

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.cover, b.views, b.likes, b.dislikes, b.collections, b.publish_time, b.create_time, u.id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar, c.name AS category, l.like_time AS likeTime FROM `like` l JOIN blog b ON l.blog_id = b.id JOIN user u ON b.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.comment_id IS NULL
AND (b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') OR b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%'))
AND b.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY l.like_time DESC
